item.title: Pig squeals used to measure welfare
item.description: The Swiss Federal Institute of Technology is studying the sounds pigs make to determine their welfare.

item.title: Concerns raised about food shortages
item.description: The World Bank will make $30 billion available to help stem a food security crisis threatened by Russia's war in Ukraine, which has cut off most grain exports from the two countries, reported Reuters news agency.

item.title: Bird flu toll rises to 1.8 million birds
item.description: The Canadian Food Inspection Agency puts the toll from highly pathogenic avian influenza at 1,822,500.

item.title: Robert’s Farm Equipment acquires Earth Power’s Owen Sound and Meaford locations
item.description: Robert's Farm Equipment Sales Inc. will acquire the Owen Sound and Meaford locations of Earth Power Tractors and Equipment in a deal set to finalize June 30th, 2022.

item.title: AGRIS promotes digital planning strategy
item.description: The next evolution in connecting with AGRIS Co-operative's owners and customers is through a strategic planning process called the 'AGRIS Digital Strategy.'

item.title: McDonald’s selling out of Russia
item.description: McDonald's Corp. plans to sell its business in Russia because Russian President Vladimir Putin invaded Ukraine.

item.title: Enhanced insurance available to canola farmers
item.description: Farmers Edge Inc. announced enhancements to Canola Heat Blast Yield Protection, an innovative insurance product distributed through its wholly owned subsidiary, DigiAg Risk Management Inc.

item.title: Ontario Pork partners with Toronto football club
item.description: Maple Leaf Sports and Entertainment, owner of Toronto FC soccer club, is partnering with the Ontario Pork marketing board to offer fans pork foods.
